readiness_interpretation: The paper blueprint and claim-to-artifact package are ready. Scientific paper claims, human construct validity, scaled benchmark validity, learned end-to-end findings, and public release remain blocked.

real_family_mining.dependency: Complete, frozen, non-smoke canonical four-source full-timeline index

claims.claim: AV-TRACE implements auditable matched CLEAN, BLOCKED, RESTORED, and no-trigger execution under fixed budgets.
claims.allowed_wording_now: The infrastructure executes and independently replays matched C/B/R episodes and no-trigger controls under fixed budgets.
claims.forbidden_wording_now: The current benchmark validates learned-agent recovery on human-gold families.

claims.claim: Restoration uses a common supported-answer endpoint, and final-point route certificates operationalize premature stopping.
claims.allowed_wording_now: The protocol defines common-endpoint restoration and can score final-point premature stopping with evaluator-private route certificates.
claims.forbidden_wording_now: Current learned agents recover or abstain correctly.
required_future_artifacts: H2 learned C/B/R and no-trigger trajectories

claims.claim: Pinned learned visual and audio retrieval plus fixed no-training fusion are reproducible.
claims.allowed_wording_now: Wave R uses audited pinned learned modality retrievers and fixed no-training RRF.
claims.forbidden_wording_now: Wave R uses learned multimodal fusion or proves general retriever superiority.

claims.claim: The provisional full-timeline migration exposed degradation relative to the bounded candidate universe.
claims.allowed_wording_now: The machine-provisional Scale-1A migration exposed full-timeline retrieval degradation, including one retained-family exclusion.
claims.forbidden_wording_now: Full-timeline retrieval is universally harder by the observed amount.

claims.claim: For the tested frozen encoders and provisional families, generic learned modality retrievers did not consistently improve evidence localization.
claims.allowed_wording_now: On five machine-provisional families, the tested learned retriever replacements often degraded ranks relative to the frozen controls.
claims.forbidden_wording_now: SigLIP2 or CLAP is generally inferior for long-video retrieval.
required_future_artifacts: Human revalidation of every accepted support route

claims.claim: AV-TRACE provides a human-adjudicated, source-disjoint benchmark of matched evidence-access interventions.
claims.allowed_wording_now: A human-adjudicated, source-disjoint benchmark is the intended contribution.
claims.forbidden_wording_now: The current repository already contains a validated human-gold benchmark.
required_future_artifacts: At least 8 H2 families and Gate B GO
60 H2 families from at least 20 source groups

claims.claim: Answer correctness and supported-answer correctness or citation validity diverge on held-out H2 families.
claims.allowed_wording_now: The protocol is designed to expose answer-versus-support divergence.
claims.forbidden_wording_now: We have shown that answer accuracy is inadequate for learned agents.
required_future_artifacts: Nonzero answer-correct but unsupported or citation-invalid set

claims.claim: AV-TRACE empirically separates evidence acquisition from at least two non-retrieval failure stages.
claims.allowed_wording_now: AV-TRACE operationalizes acquisition, grounding, citation, diagnosis, stopping, and recovery separately.
claims.forbidden_wording_now: The current results disentangle all long-video agent failures.
required_future_artifacts: At least two non-retrieval failure categories
Each category present on at least two source groups

claims.claim: Common-endpoint restoration and no-trigger controls measure recovery separately from blocked-state diagnosis.
claims.allowed_wording_now: The protocol is ready to measure restoration with a common supported-answer endpoint and no-trigger control.
required_future_artifacts: Trigger-aligned acquisition, finalization, cost, and latency

claims.claim: Explicit evidence-sufficiency control improves intervention behavior relative to ordinary learned ReAct without unacceptable CLEAN degradation.
claims.allowed_wording_now: This is a preregistered optional comparison; null or adverse outcomes will be reported.
required_future_artifacts: Gate C GO on a new unseen fictional suite
Same-backbone learned ReAct and sufficiency agents
At least 0.15 absolute improvement for a directional BLOCKED or recovery claim
paper_locations: secondary main comparison only if supported

claims.claim: Matched retrieval coverage does not fully determine grounded success, stopping, or recovery.
claims.allowed_wording_now: The experiment plan includes acquisition-conditioned and identical-observation tests.
claims.forbidden_wording_now: Current evidence proves retrieval is not the whole story.

claims.claim: A named modality is necessary for a named family or adequately sourced stratum.
claims.allowed_wording_now: Current modality assignments are routing or candidate-stratum hypotheses.
claims.forbidden_wording_now: Current visual, speech, ambient, or cross-modal labels prove necessity.
required_future_artifacts: Adequate source-group count for any aggregate stratum claim
claims.required_gate: CONSTRUCT_VALIDITY_MINI_PILOT_GO per family; PAPER_CLAIM_READY for aggregate wording

claims.claim: AV-TRACE is a release-ready public benchmark core.
claims.allowed_wording_now: Current assets are restricted research materials with artifact-specific rights boundaries.
claims.forbidden_wording_now: Current media, transcripts, annotations, embeddings, or weights are publicly redistributable.

claims.claim: AV-TRACE is the first, unique, or only long-video agentic audiovisual benchmark.
claims.allowed_wording_now: AV-TRACE combines matched evidence-access interventions with trace-level diagnosis.
claims.forbidden_wording_now: Any broad first, unique, only, SOTA, or universal wording.
claims.required_gate: No automatic promotion; only narrow wording supported by a future dated audit

top_blockers.exact_condition: At observation time the active canonical output had only segment_manifest.json and resource_manifest.json; observation_manifest.json, full_timeline_index.json, and build_manifest.json were absent.
top_blockers.resolution: Complete the active build and independently verify the complete non-smoke terminal contract.

top_blockers.exact_condition: The mining framework reports real family mining run NO, real family count 0, and final accepted family count 0.
top_blockers.resolution: After B01, execute the real miner and audit its P-tier outputs without forcing target strata.

top_blockers.exact_condition: The joint 12-family, two-calibration, six-source, reviewer, packet, seed, role, and governance gate has not been decided.
top_blockers.resolution: Assemble and independently decide the full Gate A package.

top_blockers.exact_condition: There are zero H1 and zero H2 families.
top_blockers.resolution: Complete independent human passes, adjudication, saturation, intervention isolation, and Gate B.

top_blockers.exact_condition: Existing v1/v2/v3 competence results fail semantic state, terminal, supported-answer, or abstention floors.
top_blockers.resolution: Pass Gate C on a new unseen fictional suite with a competent learned stack and independent audit.

top_blockers.exact_condition: No human-valid learned C/B/R and no-trigger evaluation exists.
top_blockers.resolution: After Gates B and C, run and audit the preregistered H2 mini diagnostic.

top_blockers.exact_condition: The 60-H2, at-least-20-source split, reserve, rights, public evaluator, and release package do not exist.
top_blockers.resolution: Pass scale authorization, corpus freeze, main evaluation, and final release/claim audits.

six_week_critical_path.name: finish_index_and_run_real_mining
six_week_critical_path.start_state: Four-source full-timeline build active; real miner fail-closed.
six_week_critical_path.required_exit: Frozen complete non-smoke four-source index plus audited real P-tier candidate registry or an explicit honest shortfall.

six_week_critical_path.name: independent_human_passes
six_week_critical_path.required_exit: Complete role-separated forms, full-source searches, counterfactuals, isolation checks, and repair queue.

six_week_critical_path.name: strong_learned_competence
six_week_critical_path.required_exit: LEARNED_CONTROLLER_READY GO, REPAIR, or NO-GO with learned generation readiness also established.

six_week_critical_path.name: h2_mini_diagnostic_and_scale_decision
six_week_critical_path.required_exit: END_TO_END_DIAGNOSTIC_GO, REPAIR, or NO-GO and first-40 authorization decision only.

prohibited_claims: Current machine-provisional SESs, necessity groups, support intervals, or modality labels are human gold.
AV-TRACE is already a validated benchmark.
AV-TRACE is the first, unique, or only long-video agentic audiovisual benchmark.
Current controller results demonstrate learned-agent recovery or superiority.
Syntax validity establishes semantic controller competence.
SigLIP2 or CLAP is generally superior or inferior for long-video retrieval.
The fixed RRF baseline is learned multimodal fusion.
Current restricted media, transcripts, annotations, embeddings, vectors, or model weights are publicly redistributable.
Episodes or families from one source are statistically independent.
RESTORED supported-answer success minus BLOCKED diagnosis success is restoration gain.
Negative, null, excluded, invalid, or failed strata may be omitted.
